 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. While the football team packs for Champaign, the Iowa men's hoops team hits the road themselves tonight for their first true road game of the season – a date with undefeated Xavier inside the Cintas Center in Cincinnati.
 Ben McCollum's squad arrives at 2-2 and stewing over what might have been. The two losses came by a combined six points: an 88-93 overtime heartbreaker against Virginia Tech in Sioux City where Iowa missed 16 free throws, then Sunday's 69-70 loss to Creighton in Des Moines, where the Hawkeyes dug out of a 12-point halftime hole, tied it late and watched two good looks rim out in the final seconds. Trevin Jirak poured in a career-high 22 that day before fouling out, and Cooper Koch leads the team at 14.3 points a game while shooting 43.8% from three. ESPN's BPI still likes this group at #31 nationally – the results just haven't caught up to the metrics yet.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Xavier will be the stiffest test so far. The Musketeers are 5-0 in year two under Richard Pitino, 4-0 at Cintas and collecting AP votes after handling Mississippi State 81-63 on a neutral floor last week. They did wobble Tuesday, needing a late 7-0 run to shake pesky Cleveland State, so they're beatable. Keep an eye on guard Tru Washington, who leads Xavier at 12.4 points and 6.4 boards a game and big man Mike Nwoko, who went for 19 and 10 in that Cleveland State escape.
 Tonight is the back half of a home-and-home the schools agreed to before either coach was hired and the Hawkeyes won the first leg 81-62 at Carver a year ago. It's just the fifth meeting ever between the programs. FanDuel Sportsbook has Xavier favored by 3.5 with a total of 144.5, giving us an implied final of Xavier 74, Iowa 70.5.
 Tip-off is scheduled for 6:30 pm CT. Here's a look at the full details for tonight's matchup.
 Date: Friday, November 20th
 Time: 6:30 pm CT
 Matchup: Iowa Hawkeyes (2-2) at Xavier Musketeers (5-0)
 Location: Cintas Center, Cincinnati, OH
 TV: TNT
 FanDuel Opening Line: Xavier -3.5, O/U 144.5
